findings.current: Saber Force surged along a crescent saber, sending three or four arms and legs flying.
findings.defect: The source counts three or four people whose limbs are severed, not three or four severed limbs.
findings.rationale: 서너 명의 specifies the number of people.
findings.replacement: Saber Force surged along a crescent saber, sending limbs flying from three or four men.
findings.source: 신월도를 타고 솟구친 도기(刀氣)에 서너 명의 팔다리가 날아간다.

findings.current: The sight of countless horsemen charging toward them, raising a hazy cloud of dust from barely a hundred yards away, did not shake a single one of them.
findings.defect: A hundred-odd jang is roughly three hundred yards, not a hundred yards.
findings.rationale: 장 is a unit of length substantially longer than a yard.
findings.replacement: The sight of countless horsemen charging toward them through a hazy cloud of dust, just over three hundred yards away, did not shake a single one of them.
findings.source: 불과 백여 장 밖, 희뿌연 먼지구름을 일으키며 마주 달려오는 수많은 인마의 모습에도 누구 하나 동요하지 않았다.

findings.current: They had all already accepted that they might die.
findings.defect: Accepting the possibility of death weakens their stated resolve to face it.
findings.rationale: 죽음을 각오했다 expresses a firm readiness to die.
findings.replacement: They had all already steeled themselves to die.

findings.current: And they are the ones our family tried to turn away!
findings.defect: “Turn away” suggests refusing the Shanxi people entry; the family considered ignoring their plight.
findings.rationale: 외면하려 했던 refers to withholding help, as the following reflection confirms.
findings.replacement: And they are the very people our family tried to turn its back on!
findings.source: 더불어 본가(本家)가 외면하려 했던 그들이다!

findings.current: “Losers too weak to stand before a fighter’s spear and blade!”
findings.defect: The answer omits the image of enemies kneeling in defeat.
findings.rationale: 무릎 꿇을 explicitly describes what the enemies will do before the fighters’ weapons.
findings.replacement: “Weak losers who will kneel before a fighter’s spear and blade!”
findings.source: 투사의 창칼 앞에 무릎 꿇을, 나약한 패자(敗者)입니다!

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it changes an injury count, a distance, and several meaningful cues about resolve and allegiance.
